hardness_axes.name: Discover
hardness_axes.reasoning: Agents must recover SMP tie-break, reserve-vs-energy status polarity, and clause-id vocabulary from contest_rules, puzzle sheets, and sealed judge probes — none of these are fully spelled as algorithms in instruction.

hardness_axes.name: Synthesize
hardness_axes.reasoning: Twelve rounds couple commitment choice, SMP, reserve binding, and refutation clauses; kiosk false-greens interact with judge-accepted lines across the booklet.

hardness_axes.name: Diagnose
hardness_axes.reasoning: Instruction is tournament symptoms (play puzzles, sealed judge authoritative, kiosk disagrees) without naming which rounds are infeasible vs reserve_short or how SMP is chosen.

hardness_axes.name: Navigate coupling
hardness_axes.reasoning: Treating every energy-feasible line as feasible_clear fails reserve_short rounds; wrong SMP or missing clause refutations fail distant cells even when cleared sets look locally plausible.

hardness_axes.name: Reason beyond training
hardness_axes.reasoning: Day-ahead clearing as a sealed contest with force-style feasible_clear vs reserve_short certificates and clause refutations is out-of-distribution versus textbook merit-order homework.

discovery_budget.discovery: Energy-feasible clearings that miss reserve demand must be status reserve_short with reserve_binds true, not infeasible.
discovery_budget.planned_location: environment/docs/contest_rules.md scenario prose + sealed judge behavior
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the polarity as a checklist collapses half the booklet to transcription.

discovery_budget.discovery: Which rulebook clause_id blocks the naive full-clear on each blocked round.
discovery_budget.planned_location: environment/docs/contest_rules.md clause list + per-puzzle sheets under environment/puzzles/
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: A pasted mapping is an answer key for refutation fields.

discovery_budget.discovery: SMP equals the offer_price of the marginal cleared unit under the house tie-break recoverable from worked examples / judge probes.
discovery_budget.planned_location: environment/docs/ plus judge accept/reject on sample lines; optional history snippets under environment/history/
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Publishing the closed-form marginal rule turns SMP into a one-liner and weakens distant cells.

discovery_budget.discovery: Kiosk projector lines are non-authoritative even when they look energy-feasible.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Instruction may say judge is authoritative but must not enumerate which kiosk lines are wrong.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Instruction will state play/contest outcomes and card vocabulary without clearing algorithms, per-round answers, or fix sites.

attack_path.summary: Agent reads puzzles and rules, probes judge.jar, ignores kiosk, searches commitments, files card via run_clearing_card.sh.
attack_path.reasoning: Primary activity is contest adjudication under a sealed judge, matching games category and idea proposal.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: No single environment patch solves the task; a wrong global merit-order script fails reserve_short and refutation cells.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: Hardness lives in the twelve-round status matrix and judge certificates, not one code flip.

collapse_audit.reasoning: Editable frontier is puzzle reasoning + card emission helpers; residual hardness is multi-status adjudication under sealed judge with kiosk bait.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: Correct feasible_clear lines still fail if SMP/reserve/refutations are wrong on other rounds; judge rejects naive full-clears.
